definitions.ask: When a task is both held by its own prerequisite and in a blocked project, which mark wins?
definitions.why: In a project note every resident would show ^; the own blocker's chips sit right beneath it

choices.label: Own prerequisite shows & even inside a blocked project; residents stand out
Project-blocked rows always show ^, matching blocked.md's grouping exactly

definitions.ask: Which glyph should the project-blocked (held by its project) checkbox draw?
definitions.why: Matches Bob's typographic checkbox alphabet; a one-mask swap later if it doesn't land

choices.label: A ^ chevron mask; ties to ^prj and reads as "the reason is above you"
A Lucide folder-lock mask; more literal for strangers, busier at 16 px

definitions.ask: How strongly should rows waiting for a date (hollow marks) tint the line?
definitions.why: The research's point is that real blockers should be the only loud red rows

choices.label: About 5.5% red tint with a 45% rail; held-by-work rows stand out (109 vs 478)
Today's 13% red tint and full rail; only the checkbox changes

definitions.ask: Record an accepted decision that Blocked checkboxes show their reason while storage stays [?]?
definitions.requested: I agree with all of the requirements recommended in that research file (but keep in mind that you are responsible for planning and splitting up this work appropriately).
